change_summary: Fault-recovery measurement repair: Polymarket Gamma /events silently ignores its search parameter, so since 2026-07-03 all six prediction-market observer queries received one identical generic event page (identical candidate counts 1205->1239 across queries) and relevance rejected nearly everything, starving the surface to a constant 2 items/day and freezing the parked lane's quantitative reopen counters (entry-date span stuck at 3, top-query share 0.798, zero nonzero probability changes across 501 markets in 16 days). Switched collection to the verified /public-search?q= endpoint (events_status=active, limit_per_type=100); per-query pages now differ and 2026-07-18 collected 33 relevant unique items (vs 2), flowing into the rebuilt outcome ledger (631 source items, 3819 candidate rows). Observer-only: no signal, ranking, sizing, exit, or order path touched; 61 tests pass.

hypothesis: The prediction-market event observer's Polymarket Gamma /events 'search' parameter is silently ignored upstream, so since 2026-07-03 all six queries receive one identical generic event page, relevance rejects nearly everything, and the parked prediction-market lane's quantitative reopen counters (unique settled candidates across dates/query groups, nonzero probability changes, 5pp moves) are structurally unable to advance; switching collection to the working /public-search endpoint restores relevant first-seen accumulation and re-observation probability deltas without changing any trading behavior.
notes: Do not read the pre-repair settled sample as alpha evidence: 3361 unique settled decisions are dominated by the 2026-07-02 day-1 generic seed page (top query share 79.8%) and span only 3 entry dates. The reopen audit must restart from post-repair first-seen rows. Zero-ID side audits recorded in the artifact: exit_lifecycle settled h5 482->517 (+7.3%) stays below the axis-(c) >=+50% bar; do not reserve an exit-lifecycle probe yet.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The upstream Gamma /events endpoint ignores its search parameter (probe: with/without search returned byte-identical pages), so all six queries consumed one generic stale-ordered page; the day-1 (2026-07-02) build had looser relevance and seeded 560 mostly generic items, then the 07-03 relevance tightening correctly rejected the generic page, exposing the fetch starvation as a constant 2 items/day. Switching to /public-search?q= (verified to filter and return same-day-updated relevant events) restored per-query collection: 33 relevant unique items on 2026-07-18.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not reserve IDs to re-audit this surface daily, to re-slice the pre-repair settled ledger (dominated by the day-1 generic seed page), or to tune relevance groups/query wording/limit params as if they were alpha evidence. The parked prediction-market alpha lane stays parked under its existing quantitative reopen condition.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Post-repair first-seen accumulation only: >=60 unique settled candidates spanning >=10 entry dates and >=3 query groups, top ticker <=15%, top query <=50%, >=20 nonzero probability changes and >=10 moves >=5pp under the frozen exposure map, all counted from rows first seen after 2026-07-18.
